quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: Taking drugs with alcohol:

options.text: Increases the risk of a crash.
Is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
Reduces the effect of alcohol on driving ability.
Does not affect your driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of a crash.
questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) affect your brain and impair driving. Combining alcohol with other drugs increases crash risk.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The maximum speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive this speed through the intersection.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: If stranded in a snowstorm, you should:

options.text: Leave your car to get help.
Lay down in your car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in your car. Help will find you there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car. Help will find you there.
questions.explanation: If stranded in a snowstorm, stay in your car and wait for help. Rescuers will find you more easily in your vehicle. Walking around in a snowstorm is unsafe.

questions.question: A driver taking a non-prescription drug should:

options.text: Read the label before driving.
Drink alcohol instead.
Keep driving even if there are warnings.
Drive only during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: Read the label before driving.
questions.explanation: Many over-the-counter medicines can affect your driving. Check the label for warnings about cold or allergy medicine. If unsure, ask your doctor or pharmacist if it is safe to drive.

questions.question: A "No standing" sign means:

options.text: You can never stop your vehicle there.
You can park there if the driver stays in the vehicle.
You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
You can stop to load or unload goods.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
questions.explanation: A "No standing" sign means you can only make a quick stop to pick up or drop off passengers.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Winding road.
No parking.
Right lane closed.
Multiple turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns drivers of a winding road ahead. Slow down and prepare for curves.

questions.question: To prepare for hazards ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the entire road and sides.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Rest your left foot lightly on the brake pedal.
Focus on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the entire road and sides.
questions.explanation: Look far ahead and search for problems before you reach them. Scan the entire road, including both sides. Do not just stare at the center.

questions.question: An octagonal sign is always a:

options.text: Speed limit sign.
Stop sign.
Hospital sign.
Railroad warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are always stop signs. Come to a complete stop at every red octagonal sign.

questions.question: You can use parking lights instead of headlights when driving at night.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You must use headlights when driving at night or in low visibility. Using only parking lights is illegal.

questions.question: When passing on a two-lane road with traffic in both directions, you should:

options.text: Return to your lane when you have enough space from the passed vehicle.
Stay in the left lane if you plan to turn left.
Return to the right lane immediately.
Drive in either lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to your lane when you have enough space from the passed vehicle.
questions.explanation: After passing on a two-lane road, return to the right lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Use the proper turn signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: U-turns are not allowed.
U-turns are allowed.
Winding road ahead.
Sharp left turn ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: U-turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What is the 'No zone'?

options.text: The blind spots around a truck or bus where other vehicles cannot be seen.
A special speed zone.
A roadway where vehicle stereo volume is limited.
A television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spots around a truck or bus where other vehicles cannot be seen.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on the sides, rear, and front. Cars in these areas cannot be seen by the truck or bus driver. These areas are called the 'No zone.'

questions.question: How can you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use the inside rearview mirror.
Use the outside rearview mirror.
Use both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only behind your vehicle.
Only on the left and right sides.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to vehicles on your left and right.

questions.question: A railroad crossing sign should be treated the same as a yield sign.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing sign is a yield sign. You must yield the right-of-way to any trains and railroad equipment.

questions.question: Which statement is true about seat belts and child restraints?

options.text: Never put an infant or small child in the front seat of a vehicle with airbags.
An airbag can harm an infant or small child, even in a low-speed crash.
Always make sure all passengers use a seat belt or child restraint.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Before driving, fasten your seat belt and make sure all passengers use seat belts or child restraints. Seat belts greatly reduce the risk of injury or death in a crash. Children 12 and under should sit in the rear seat with proper restraints. Never place a rear-facing infant restraint in the front seat of a vehicle with an airbag.

questions.question: What happens if you drive in Virginia without liability insurance?

options.text: You face a $500 fee.
Your driver license will be suspended.
Your insurance premiums will increase.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: If caught driving without insurance, the DMV will suspend your license until you pay a $500 fee and have your insurance company file proof that you have the required coverage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Steep downgrade ahead.
Crossroad ahead.
No right turn.
Narrow bridge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a crash.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No left turn.
No U-turns.
No exit.
No right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp, what should you do?

options.text: Should yield to drivers already on the highway.
Has the right-of-way.
May force your way into traffic.
Can assume that other drivers will change lanes for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should yield to drivers already on the highway.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway from a ramp, you must yield to cars already on the highway. Merge safely when there is space.

questions.question: If a police officer stops you, what should you do?

options.text: Unbuckle your seat belt and lower your window.
Get your paperwork ready before the officer reaches your car.
Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
Get out of your car and walk toward the patrol car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the wheel and tell passengers to keep their hands visible. Stay in your car unless the officer tells you to get out. Wait for the officer to ask for your license, registration, and insurance card.

questions.question: You do not have to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights if it is on a private road.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You must stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on both public and private roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol socially, what helps you drive safely?

options.text: Drink coffee before driving.
Get a ride home with a sober friend.
Take a cold shower before driving.
Stop drinking 30 minutes before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get a ride home with a sober friend.
questions.explanation: Arrange a ride with a friend who has not been drinking. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your system. Your body eliminates about one drink per hour.

questions.question: The posted speed limit is the fastest you can legally drive in an area.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest legal speed under good conditions. You must slow down when the road is slippery or when visibility is poor.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Curve.
Turn right or left.
Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: When may you drive across a dashed white line?

options.text: At any time.
Only during daylight hours.
When it is safe to change lanes.
Only when passing a motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross them to change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is nearby.
Signal only if other traffic is visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Do not skip signaling just because you do not see other cars.

questions.question: You cannot pass on either side of a ____ centerline.

options.text: Combination solid and broken yellow
Single broken yellow
Double solid yellow
Single broken white

questions.correctAnswerText: Double solid yellow
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no one can cross it to pass. This applies to traffic going both directions.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find an alternative route across tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is near or moving fast enough to be dangerous, do not cross. This is true even if there are no signals or signals are broken.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Keep right.
Keep left.
Pass with caution.
No passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: Traffic signals use arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A green arrow means:

options.text: Is used only on one-way streets.
You can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may proceed only if a circular green light is also showing.
Points the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can proceed. You must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Never drive through, around, or under any railroad gate or barrier.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Do not drive through, around, or under railroad crossing gates or barriers. It is illegal and dangerous.
